notes.title: Early Access 1
notes.notes:
Timber tales goes into early access with update 1!

This release contains the start of the future with 3 vehicles, 4 quests, 2 biomes, 5 trees, and 4 axes.

Plenty of work to do from here but excited for community feedback!

notes.title: Alpha 2
notes.notes: Bug fixes, Ace's Axes and Vinnie's Vehicles new buildings. New town home area with other new terrain nearby. Benni's Forge now glows.

notes.title: Alpha 1
notes.notes: Implementation of Volcanic Biome along with 2 new tree's (Coal and Copper), 3 new Quests, 2 new NPC's, new sawmill design and upgrade system, 1 new axe, new vehicle system, 1 new "vehicle" (is a wheelbarrow a vehicle?", swimming system, and finally 3 new achievements...
